newsitem.title: USA: Former Astra USA consultant pleads not guilty.
newsitem.headline: Former Astra USA consultant pleads not guilty.

text.p: A former consultant for Astra USA Inc pleaded not guilty on Tuesday to charges he conspired with the former chief executive to defraud $1 million from the drug company.

Lars Magnusson, a consultant in 1988 and 1989 and again in 1996, allegedly conspired with former Astra USA Chief Executive Lars Bildman to defraud the company by instructing contractors to do work for Bildman at the company's expense, the U.S. Attorney's office in Massachusetts said.
Magnusson, 61, owner of Stockholm-based Data Produktion AB, was freed on a $100,000 bond secured by his wife's Auburn, Maine home.

Bildman also pleaded not guilty to the charges. He has plead not guilty to previous charges of fraud, filing false tax statements and travelling across state lines to engage in prostitution previously posted against him.
Astra USA is a unit of Swedish pharmaceutical giant Astra Ab.
